title: The Jacobian conjecture and affine spaces
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: Polynomial maps and affine spaces: Keller maps and the reduction of the Jacobian conjecture to injectivity, with a complete hand proof that an explicit map of three-space with Jacobian determinant -2 identifies three points; coordinates and a degree-17 polynomial in four variables whose zero set is affine three-space but which is not a coordinate; locally nilpotent derivations, additive actions and their lifts to line bundles; a fourfold whose cylinder is affine five-space but which is not affine four-space, so that Zariski cancellation fails in dimension four in characteristic zero; a polynomial in five variables that becomes a coordinate after adjoining one variable, with explicit complementary coordinates, but is not a coordinate; a degree-five stable coordinate in four variables that is not a coordinate; and smooth affine-space fibrations over the line, the plane and a discrete valuation ring, all of whose fibres are affine three-space, which are not locally trivial.
prerequisites: AG-CA (commutative algebra: Nullstellensatz, Krull dimension, dimension theory of local rings, integral extensions)
AG-MO lesson on the dimension of fibres
Course projective-modules-and-locally-polynomial-algebras (lesson locally-polynomial-algebras: Lemmas 1.2, 1.3, Corollary 2.2; lesson horrocks-and-quillen-suslin: Lemma 1.1)

AG-CA lessons tor-and-flat-modules (Propositions 3.1, 3.2, Theorem 3.3), faithful-flatness-and-the-local-criterion-for-flatness (Theorem 5.2, slicing lemma) and formally-smooth-unramified-and-etale-ring-maps (definitions of formally smooth and smooth ring maps)
